newsitem.title: USA: Dodge City feeder steers not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Dodge City feeder steers not tested - USDA.

text.p: Compared with last week - not enough feeders of any class for a market test, 50 percent of the feeder supply Holsteins Large 2, few 1 preconditioned out of a starter yard.
Receipts 61 percent 600 lbs and over; 29 percent 600 lbs and under; 10 percent cows and bulls with 140 early.

Feeder Steers - (Figures in parentheses are weighted average prices) Medium and Large 1 12 head 531 lbs 89.50; 12 head 580 lbs 85.00; 42 head 634 lbs 86.50; 20 head 655 lbs 87.25; 850-900 lbs 78.60. Medium and Large 1-2 450-500 lbs 85.00-85.50 (85.29); 500-550 lbs 80.00- 82.50 (81.45); 10 head 571 lbs 80.00; 14 head 949 lbs 70.25. Large 2, few 1 Holsteins - (preconditioned out of a starter yard) 450-500 lbs 74.00; 98 head 563 lbs 76.00; 650-700 lbs 70.25-70.85 (70.55); 750-800 lbs 65.70-66.60 (66.14); 850-900 lbs 63.10-63.75 (63.43).
